general.compressionDepth: At least 2 inches (5 cm), no more than 2.4 inches (6 cm)
general.recoilAdvice: Allow full chest recoil between every push; avoid leaning on the chest.
general.ratioHandsOnly: Continuous uninterrupted chest compressions (no mouth-to-mouth required for untrained bystanders).

steps.title: Hand Placement Between the Breasts
steps.keyAction: Center of the chest, interlock fingers
steps.description: Place the heel of one hand in the center of the breastbone (between the breasts / nipple line). Place your other hand on top and interlock fingers.
detailPoints: Position yourself directly over the victim's chest with arms straight and elbows locked.
Push strictly on the breastbone (sternum). CPR on a woman is anatomically identical to CPR on a man.
Do not hesitate due to modesty or fear of touching the chest—you are saving a life.

steps.title: Push Hard and Fast to the Beat
steps.keyAction: Push down 2 inches (5 cm) at 110 BPM
steps.description: Push hard and fast straight down. Match your compression tempo to the 110 BPM metronome beeps.
detailPoints: Depth: Push down firmly at least 2 inches (5 cm).
Use your upper body weight, pivoting at your hips, to avoid arm fatigue.
Allow complete chest recoil between each compression so the heart can refill with blood.

steps.title: Keep Going Until Help or AED Arrives
steps.description: Do not stop compressions unless the victim starts clearly moving, breathing normally, or emergency personnel take over.
detailPoints: If another bystander is present, switch rescuers every 2 minutes without stopping compressions for more than 5 seconds.
When an AED arrives, turn it on immediately and follow its loud voice prompts.
If AED prompts you to apply pads, expose chest, attach pads as shown on AED diagrams, and follow spoken commands.

aedInstructions.title: Automated External Defibrillator (AED)
aedInstructions.alertMessage: Send someone to fetch an AED immediately. Do not leave the victim alone if you are the sole rescuer.
steps: Turn on the AED unit as soon as it arrives.
Follow the voice instructions. Peel off backing and stick pads onto bare chest as pictured.
Stand clear when the AED analyzes rhythm or delivers a shock.
Resume chest compressions immediately after shock or if advised 'no shock needed'.
